newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Union Bank of Taiwan closes US $50 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Union Bank of Taiwan closes US $50 mln FRCD.

text.p: Union Bank of Taiwan's US$50 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has closed, arranger Societe Generale Asia said Monday.
The facility has a final maturity of three years with put and call options in year two. The issue was priced at par to float at 27.5 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier participants is 32.5 basis points.
First Chicago Hong Kong, Societe Generale Asia and WestLB are arrangers.
Merrill Lynch Far East and BZW Asia are senior managers.
Monte Dei Paschi Di Siena Singapore, Tokyo-Mitsubishi International Hong Kong, LTCB Asia, Taiwan Cooperative Bank, United Taiwan Bank and International Commercial Bank of China are managers.
